title: Join the front_end and back_end lists
description:
Join the following lists:

front_end = ['HTML', 'CSS', 'JS', 'React', 'Redux']
back_end = ['Node','Express', 'MongoDB']

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as join_tech_lists(front_end, back_end), returning a new list with all items of front_end followed by all items of back_end.
hints: Two lists can be combined into one with an arithmetic-looking operator.
The order of the result follows the order the lists are combined in.
expected_behavior: Returns a new list with front_end's items followed by back_end's items.
solution:
def join_tech_lists(front_end, back_end):
    return front_end + back_end
explanation: The + operator on two lists concatenates them, producing a single list with the first list's items followed by the second's.
